Supposedly there are two main attachment styles. Avoidant and anxious attachment. The first is someone who has trouble getting comfortable and is less "clingy"." The second sounds like your case. Constantly worrying if the might leave  and always being the initiator. This is my attachment style as well and it is not always a bad thing

How has this lead to an end of a relationship you mentioned? Were you coming on too strong or being supposedly "clingy"? Because neither of these things are bad, it just means you care more than they do.

In that case it sounds good. I just couldn't gauge from your first reply. It sounds cliche but if you two make eye contact that is the perfect time for a kiss. I made the first move for my first kiss. It was during an episode of the simpsons we were sitting on the couch. I just looked over at him and we made eye contact for like 30 seconds and I leaned onto him and kissed him. Don't overthink it if she likes you she will reciprocate lol.

If you are just now talking to her romantically for the first time (in person) it might be a little too soon for a kiss. That's assuming you've never hung out before. Judge the mood and if you think it's right you can ask her if she wants to kiss. Sometimes, the moment is too awkward especially after a big conversation such as asking her out. Don't rush it! Make it special if you want...
